            c+=1;idx+=1;o[row][c]=pattern[idx%len(pattern)]
        if c+1<m:o[row][c+1]=marker
        return c
    def vert_all(col):
        if col in seen or not (0<=col<m):return
        seen.add(col)
        runs=[];r=0
        while r<n:
            if inp[r][col]!=corridor:r+=1;continue
            top=r
